summary.intent: Execute Phase 60 ('IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout') of CipherBox using the GSD wave-based execution workflow, closing out IPNS verification gaps (seq=0→1 unification, fail-closed verify paths, EOL/expiry enforcement) across Rust and TypeScript layers in 4 dependency-ordered waves.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (60-01, 60-02, 60-03) completed fully — 251/251 sdk-core tests green. Wave 2 reached 60-04 complete and 60-05 in-flight when the transcript ends; the session is mid-phase with 4/8 plans done.

repo: crates/fuse/src/verify.rs was a re-export shim that 60-04 deleted after 60-01 moved the canonical impl to crates/api-client/src/ipns.rs — sdk/fuse/desktop now share one verify chokepoint
First-publish IPNS sequence was 0 across 9 producers (FUSE, desktop Tauri, sdk-core, web); unified to 1 in 60-02 as a precondition for the strict resolve verifier
cipherbox-api-client gained ciborium + cipherbox-core as new deps after 60-01 added CBOR Validity/expiry parsing — Cargo.lock must be committed alongside Cargo.toml edits
sdk-core has 251 tests total, 34 of which are ipns-specific; these serve as the Wave 1 integration gate
60-01 folded all 9 FUSE VerifyError::Legacy caller arms as a compile necessity, preempting scope nominally assigned to 60-04

code.finding: Had a VerifyError::Legacy arm that 60-01 folded to VerifyError::Invalid when removing the Legacy variant; a mid-edit compiler snapshot made this look like a lingering error but it was already fixed
Had a stale expectation of 0n for first-publish sequence; updated to 1n by 60-03 executor after 60-02 changed all producers

workflow: Worktree isolation mode was dropped in favor of sequential subagents on the feature branch because the GSD harness has no reliable merge-back protocol for worktree agent branches — critical for a security/crypto phase
The gsd commit helper reports commit_failed as a false negative — commits may have actually landed; always verify with git log before taking recovery action
Executor subagents can commit Cargo.toml edits without committing the resulting Cargo.lock delta, creating a latent --locked CI break that must be caught between waves
Stray SUMMARY.md footer content can be appended after an executor's main commit, leaving the file in a factually incorrect state that needs manual revert

friction: gsd commit helper false-negative: reported commit_failed for the Cargo.lock fixup commit but the commit had actually landed (9fb576365) — required an extra git log verification step
60-01 executor left Cargo.lock uncommitted after editing Cargo.toml, discovered only during 60-04's post-merge cleanup rather than at plan boundary
60-01 executor appended a stale self-check footer to 60-01-SUMMARY.md after its main commit, requiring a manual revert before wave 2 could continue
Spurious mid-edit compile diagnostic (VerifyError::Legacy in metadata.rs:619) triggered an extra grep + cargo check round-trip to confirm the tree was actually clean
open_items: Wave 2 plan 60-05 (tighten API to strict regime: seq=1 enforce on publish, parseCachedRecord null on missing signed_record, remove legacy DB-sequence override) was in-flight at transcript end
Wave 3 plan 60-06 (API publish-path verify cache for CPU cost recovery) not yet started
Wave 4 plan 60-08 (D-01/D-12 operational cutover: staging wipe + redeploy + smoke-test) is non-autonomous and requires a human-action checkpoint
Windows winfsp integration site for 60-02 is CI-gated only — not locally testable, so first-publish seq=1 on Windows path is unverified locally
